from jinja2 import Environment
import pytest

def test_groupby_case_insensitivity(env):
    tmpl = env.from_string('{% for key, items in ["apple", "Banana", "apple", "banana"]|groupby %}{{ key }}: {{ items|join(", ") }}{% endfor %}')
    expected_output = "Banana: Banana\napple: apple"
    assert tmpl.render() == expected_output
